Events on Martyred Intellectuals’ Day
2013-12-14T00:00:00+06:00 | Bss, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/events-on-martyred-intellectuals-day-2408

The programmes to observe Martyred Intellectuals’ Day today will begin with the hoisting of the national flag at half-mast and black flags. Wreaths will be laid at Rayer Bazar Martyred Intellectuals’ Graveyard and Martyred Intellectuals’ Memorial at Mirpur while discussions and cultural programmes will be held and human chains will be formed. Newspapers will publish special supplements while radio and television channels will air special programmes. President Abdul Hamid, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and Leader of the Opposition Khaleda Zia issued separate messages paying rich tributes to the martyrs and recalling their contributions in achieving independence. The country observes the day commemorating the nation’s intellectuals butchered at the hands of Razakars, Al-Badr and Al-Shams, collaborators of the Pakistani occupation force, in 1971. The martyrs — academics, writers, physicians, engineers, journalists and other eminent personalities — were forcibly

taken to killing fields around the country to be shot, slaughtered and bayoneted to death. The act, carried out just two days before Bangladesh achieved independence through the surrender of the Pakistani army, was aimed at depriving the new nation of its brilliant minds.
